services.name: Matanuska Getaway
services.desc: Make the most out of your three days. With the Matanuska Getaway you can fill your exploration with adventure and leave the nitty gritty details to us. We will pick you up in Anchorage and get you onto the trails to stretch out and get your first deep breaths of vacation right away. You'll enjoy mountain views and get a taste of Alaskan terrain. Afterwards, find yourself winding along scenic views of the Mat-Su Valley to start your evening zip line. Take in the scenery of the glacially carved valley and the Matanuska Glacier as you soar over a 250 ft cliff on Alaska's fastest zip line! Wind down at Alpenglow Luxury Camping for the evening. Enjoy an Alaskan style BBQ and soaks in a cedar

services.name: Maximum Exposure
services.desc: Take in the bird's eye view of Alaska and expand your horizons. This package offers breathtaking sights to multiple adventure destinations, some by helicopter. Start with a stunning drive to Prince William Sound for a day sea kayaking near glacier and ice bergs then overnight in the nearby gold rush town of Hope, Alaska (pop. 192). Thrilling whitewater action on Six Mile Creek kicks off the morning of Day 2. You'll relax in the comforts of Alpenglow Luxury Camping at the end of this exciting day. services.name: Custom Adventure Planning
services.desc: It can be overwhelming to take in all that Alaska has to offer. We are here to collaborate with you to bridge the gap between dreams and reality. Use our experience in coordinating expeditions around the world, and our familiarity with our big backyard here in Alaska, to cultivate the experience you have always wished for. Whether you are looking to get your hands dirty in the mountains, get your paddle on in the coastal regions, have an immersive educational experience, or do it all, our Alaskan experts are here to help. Getting lost in the tumultuous chaos of Anchorage whilst organizing logistics is something we want to help you avoid so you can make the most of your experience. Custom
